summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC., a Taiwan-based outsourced semiconductor assembly and test services provider dual-listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (8150) and Nasdaq (IMOS), furnished a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) reporting unaudited monthly and quarterly revenue via press release dated October 8, 2026. September 2026 revenue was NT$2,792.0 million (US$87.7 million), up 0.2% MoM and 33.8% YoY; third-quarter 2026 revenue was a record NT$8,400.8 million (US$263.8 million), up 13.8% QoQ and 36.7% YoY, on AI-related demand outpacing memory supply. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
